CONTROLLER DUALSENSE
REM DualSense (PS5) full input test: every button, the d-pad and both sticks
REM Open a gamepad tester first. Each input is pressed once, 400 ms apart.
DELAY 2000

REM ---- Face buttons ----
PRESS CROSS
DELAY 400
PRESS CIRCLE
DELAY 400
PRESS SQUARE
DELAY 400
PRESS TRIANGLE
DELAY 400

PRESS L1
DELAY 400
PRESS R1
DELAY 400
PRESS L2
DELAY 400
PRESS R2
DELAY 400

PRESS L3
DELAY 400
PRESS R3
DELAY 400

REM ---- D-pad ----
PRESS UP
DELAY 400
PRESS DOWN
DELAY 400
PRESS LEFT
DELAY 400
PRESS RIGHT
DELAY 400

PRESS UP RIGHT
DELAY 400
PRESS DOWN RIGHT
DELAY 400
PRESS DOWN LEFT
DELAY 400
PRESS UP LEFT
DELAY 400

REM ---- Both sticks at once ----
HOLD LS_UP RS_DOWN 800
DELAY 400
HOLD LS_LEFT RS_RIGHT 800
DELAY 400

REM ---- Menu buttons ----
PRESS CREATE
DELAY 400

DELAY 400

REM ---- System buttons (last: PS opens the console or Steam menu, so it comes last) ----

DELAY 400
PRESS PS
DELAY 400
